name: Capacitance X Psycho can be activated from the material deck in the main phase and enters rested
notes: Lorraine lineage with six arcane cards banished: clicking Capacitance X Psycho in the material deck puts it onto the field rested. The materialize phase only offers this clause to a player who takes part in the ordinary materialize (declining it skips the offer), so the card is also activatable by clicking it in the material deck during the main phase.

rulesClauses: [Lorraine Bonus] As long as there are six or more arcane element cards in your banishment, you may activate this card from your material deck. If you do, it enters the field rested.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Capacitance X Psycho could only be activated from the material deck through the materialize-phase offer, which a declined ordinary materialize skips; it had no main-phase activation.
